question: Is Obsidian free for personal and commercial use, and what do Sync and Publish add?
answer:
ChatGPT 说：

Yes. Obsidian is free for both personal and commercial use. You can download and use the app without paying, without creating an account, and without buying a license. The optional paid offerings are mainly services and support options. 
O
Obsidian
+1

What the free version includes

The free Obsidian app gives you the core knowledge-management features:

Unlimited notes (stored as local Markdown files)
Internal links and backlinks
Graph view
Plugins and themes
Offline use
Use at work, in a business, school, nonprofit, or personal project 
O
Obsidian

Your notes are stored locally on your device by default, rather than being stored in Obsidian’s cloud. 
O
Obsidian

What Obsidian Sync adds

Obsidian Sync is an optional paid service for keeping your vaults synchronized across devices. 
O
Obsidian

It adds:

Automatic syncing between computers and mobile devices
End-to-end encryption
Version history (restore older versions of notes)
Shared vault collaboration features
Priority support 
O
Obsidian

Pricing listed by Obsidian is:

$4 USD/user/month billed annually
$5 USD/user/month billed monthly 
O
Obsidian

You do not need Sync to use Obsidian. Many people use alternatives such as their own cloud storage or file-sync tools, though those approaches may require more setup. 
O
Obsidian Forum

What Obsidian Publish adds

Obsidian Publish lets you turn your notes into a website. 
O
Obsidian

It adds:

Publishing notes to the web
A hosted site (no server setup required)
Customizable themes
Graph view and full-text search for visitors
Priority support 
O
Obsidian

Pricing listed by Obsidian is:

$8 USD/site/month billed annually
$10 USD/site/month billed monthly 
O
Obsidian
What about the Commercial license?

The old distinction has changed: a Commercial license is now optional. Organizations can use Obsidian for work without buying one. The optional Commercial license ($50/user/year) is mainly a way for companies to support Obsidian’s development and be recognized as supporters. 
O
Obsidian
+1

A simple way to think about it:

Feature	Free Obsidian	Sync	Publish
Write and organize notes	✅	✅	✅
Local Markdown files	✅	✅	✅
Use commercially	✅	✅	✅
Sync devices automatically	❌	✅	❌
Encrypted Obsidian-managed sync	❌	✅	❌
Publish notes as a website	❌	❌	✅

For most individual users, the free version is enough. Sync is mainly worth it if you want a seamless multi-device setup, and Publish is for people who want to turn their notes into a public knowledge base, documentation site, or personal wiki.
